Start the weekend with a little extra time to unwind. Our Happy Friday package combines a stay in a Cathedral View Room with breakfast, drinks, pool access and a late check-out.

Settle in, enjoy the view of St Rumbold's Cathedral and ease into the weekend in the heart of Mechelen.
